utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the school’s trying to sort the carpool list today. Want me to see if anyone has an extra seat?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Sure, but can you confirm the school is actually adding extra seats today?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I can check, but I haven’t heard that confirmed yet. I’ll ask around and let you know if they really are adding extra seats today.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can do the carpool again if you want.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, that'd be great, thanks.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure, I’ll handle the carpool again.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, I can do the early run. What time do you need me there?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure, I can do 7:15 if that works for you.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: 7:15 works for me. See you then.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can help with that. What time were you thinking for the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: How about 8:00 tomorrow morning?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: 8:00 works for me.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can do Tuesday pickup if that still helps.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes, Tuesday pickup still helps a lot. Thanks, Faye.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, I’ll handle Tuesday pickup and confirm the timing with you later this week.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I can take the early shift, as long as we keep the route the same. Let me know what time you want me ready.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure, what time works best for you? I can keep the route the same.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Around 7:30 works for me, as long as we keep that same route.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, I’ll ask around and keep you posted.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, just let me know by tonight if there’s room for one more.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Will do — I’ll check and let you know tonight.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the carpool might be shifted a bit, but I’m not sure what time yet.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ll check and send the updated time as soon as I have it. For now, plan on a little flexibility.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, I’ll wait for your update and keep it flexible for now.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Can you remind me what time the carpool needs to leave?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I think we need to leave at 8:00.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: 8:00 works for me, but can you confirm we’re all set to leave right then?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can take the later shift if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That would help a lot, thanks. I can take the earlier part if you’ve got the later shift.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, that works for me.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, I can help with the carpool. What time do you need me there?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time should I tell the others?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Tell them I’ll be there at 7:30.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can take first pickup from my place if that works for you.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: That works for me, thanks. I can handle the next pickup.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, then I'll take the first pickup and you can handle the next one.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I can help with the carpool if you need an extra hand.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus. I appreciate it. I’ll let you know what shift still needs covering.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, just let me know which shift needs covering.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can probably help, but I need to know the pickup and drop-off times first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: What times were you thinking for pickup and drop-off? I need the details to confirm.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I was thinking pickup around 7:30 and drop-off by 4:30, but I can adjust if that doesn’t work.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can ask around and see if anyone else in the neighborhood can help with the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Jules. I appreciate you taking that on.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Of course - I’ll check with a few neighbors and let you know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep an eye on the supplies and help sort the carpool list if you need.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo. I’m usually a bit late, but I can still help keep the carpool list straight.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No worries, I’ll keep the list straight and nudge you when it’s time to leave.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the carpool got a little shuffled this week, but I can check who's driving which days if you want.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, please check that and let me know which days need a driver.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll check which days still need a driver and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, just send me the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, I’ll send the time and place shortly.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good, just text me when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can help with the carpool. What time works best for you?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can do 8:00 AM or 8:30 AM.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: 8:00 AM works for me.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, Nell—I'll spread the word about the carpool and see who else wants in.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Quinn. Let me know what you hear, and I’ll keep an ear out too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I will. I’m asking around today and I’ll let you know as soon as I have a few more names.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got the carpool location noted, Eli. Where should I meet you?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Meet me at the front entrance by the bench at 9:00. I’ll be there a few minutes early.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it, I’ll meet you at the front entrance by the bench at 9:00.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Are we still on for the carpool tomorrow?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, I think so, but let me double-check the time with you first.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time is it supposed to be?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can ask around and see who’s available for the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, that’d help a lot. I can’t keep track of all the details myself.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No problem, I’ll ask around and let you know what I find.
